entities.name: CRYAA
observations: CRYAA encodes alphaA-crystallin; a study of promoter CpG methylation in human lens epithelial cells reported increased CRYAA mRNA after zebularine treatment.

entities.name: Sp1
observations: EMSA in the CRYAA promoter methylation study reported reduced Sp1 binding to a methylated promoter DNA probe.

entities.name: PMID:27507241
observations: In HLE B-3 cells, methylation of a selected CRYAA promoter DNA probe reduced Sp1 binding by EMSA; zebularine increased CRYAA mRNA, but this global demethylation does not establish that the tested CpG alone causes transcriptional change.
